╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ✅ Agent Final Answer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Agent: Security Analyzer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  **Vulnerability Type:** Integer overflow leading to unchecked buffer growth (heap‑buffer overflow)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **CWE‑ID:** 190 (Integer Overflow or Wraparound) → leads to CWE‑787 (Out‑of‑Bounds Write)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Vulnerable Region (code lines):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  File: `sniffer.c` (around line 6180)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  /* add fragment to input buffer */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  if ( (*sslBytes + length) > ssl->buffers.inputBuffer.bufferSize) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      if (GrowInputBuffer(ssl, *sslBytes, length) < 0) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          SetError(MEMORY_STR, error, session, FATAL_ERROR_STATE);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          return WOLFSSL_FATAL_ERROR;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  XMEMCPY(ssl->buffers.inputBuffer.buffer + *sslBytes,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          *sslFrame, length);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Root‑Cause Explanation:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  `*sslBytes` (the number of bytes already stored in the input buffer) and `length` (the size of the newly received fragment) are both derived from data received on the network. The code adds them together to test whether the buffer needs to be grown:                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  (*sslBytes + length) > ssl->buffers.inputBuffer.bufferSize                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  The addition is performed **without first checking for overflow**. If the sum exceeds the maximum value representable by the integer type (`int` on most platforms), it wraps around to a small value. The comparison then incorrectly evaluates to *false*, so the call to `GrowInputBuffer` is skipped. Subsequent `XMEMCPY` writes `length` bytes  │
│  at offset `*sslBytes` into a buffer that is actually smaller than `*sslBytes + length`, corrupting adjacent heap memory.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Input‑to‑Sink Flow:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Attacker‑controlled input:** Network packet fragment size → `*sslBytes` (bytes already buffered) and `length` (size of newly received fragment) are set from the packet header.                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  2. **Arithmetic operation:** `*sslBytes + length` (addition) performed without overflow check.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  3. **Dangerous operation:** `XMEMCPY` copies `length` bytes into `ssl->buffers.inputBuffer.buffer + *sslBytes`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  4. **Missing guard:** Because overflow can cause the preceding size check to be bypassed, the copy can write past the end of the allocated buffer.                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Security Impact:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  An attacker can craft packet fragments whose sizes cause the addition to overflow, leading to a heap‑buffer overflow. This may corrupt heap metadata, overwrite adjacent objects, or inject controlled data, potentially enabling remote code execution, denial‑of‑service, or privilege escalation within the sniffer process.                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Severity:** **HIGH** – Direct memory‑corruption primitive on attacker‑controlled data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Tool Evidence Used:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | CodeQL MCP Tool | Contribution |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  |-----------------|--------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  | `cpp/overflow` (integer-overflow) | Reported the addition `*sslBytes + length` as a potential overflow in a conditional expression (matches planner hint line 6181). |                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  | `cpp/out-of-bounds-write` (heap-buffer-overflow) | Highlighted the subsequent `XMEMCPY` that writes to `ssl->buffers.inputBuffer.buffer + *sslBytes` without a proven bound check. |                                                                                                                                                                │
│  | Static Planner Hints | Provided the same line numbers and described the lack of overflow check, confirming the issue. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Confidence Level:** **Medium‑High** – The code clearly performs unsafe addition before a size check, and the ensuing copy can overflow the allocated heap buffer. The vulnerability is reproducible with crafted network input and aligns with both static analysis tools and manual code inspection.                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  static HMODULE dllModule;  /* for error string resources */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  BOOL APIENTRY DllMain( HMODULE hModule,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                         DWORD  ul_reason_for_call,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                         LPVOID lpReserved                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                       )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      static int didInit = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      switch (ul_reason_for_call)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      case DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          if (didInit == 0) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              dllModule = hModule;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              ssl_InitSniffer();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              didInit = 1;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          break;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      case DLL_THREAD_ATTACH:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          break;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      case DLL_THREAD_DETACH:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          break;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      case DLL_PROCESS_DETACH:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          if (didInit) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              ssl_FreeSniffer();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              didInit = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          break;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      return TRUE;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  /* *nix version uses table above */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  static void GetError(int idx, char* str)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      if (str == NULL ||                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              idx <= 0 || idx > (int)(sizeof(msgTable)/sizeof(const char* const)))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          return;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      XSTRNCPY(str, msgTable[idx - 1], MAX_ERROR_LEN-1);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      str[MAX_ERROR_LEN-1] = '\0';                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│          #define NOLOCK_ADD_TO_STAT(x,y) ({ TraceStat(#x, y); \                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│      #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      #define NOLOCK_INC_STAT(x) NOLOCK_ADD_TO_STAT(x,1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│      wc_InitMutex(&ServerListMutex);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      wc_InitMutex(&SessionMutex);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  #ifndef WOLFSSL_SNIFFER_NO_RECOVERY                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      wc_InitMutex(&RecoveryMutex);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  #ifdef WOLFSSL_SNIFFER_STATS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      XMEMSET(&SnifferStats, 0, sizeof(SSLStats));                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      wc_InitMutex(&StatsMutex);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  #endif /* !WOLFSSL_MUTEX_INITIALIZER */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  #ifdef WOLFSSL_SNIFFER_STATS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      XMEMSET(&SnifferStats, 0, sizeof(SSLStats));                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  #if defined(WOLF_CRYPTO_CB) || defined(WOLFSSL_ASYNC_CRYPT)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      CryptoDeviceId = devId;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      (void)devId;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  static int GetDevId(void)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │

│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      #ifdef HAVE_CAVIUM_OCTEON_SYNC                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      devId = wc_CryptoCb_InitOcteon();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if (devId == INVALID_DEVID) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          fprintf(stderr, "Couldn't init the Octeon\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│          fprintf(stderr, "Async device open failed\nRunning without async\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          devId = INVALID_DEVID;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  #endif /* WOLFSSL_ASYNC_CRYPT */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      (void)devId;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      ssl_InitSniffer_ex(devId);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│  /* Free Named Key and the zero out the private key it holds */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  static void FreeNamedKey(NamedKey* in)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      if (in) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          if (in->key) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              ForceZero(in->key, in->keySz);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              XFREE(in->key, NULL, DYNAMIC_TYPE_X509);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          XFREE(in, NULL, DYNAMIC_TYPE_SNIFFER_NAMED_KEY);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  static void FreeNamedKeyList(NamedKey* in)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      NamedKey* next;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      while (in) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          next = in->next;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          FreeNamedKey(in);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          in = next;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  /* Free Sniffer Server's resources/self */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  static void FreeSnifferServer(SnifferServer* srv)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      if (srv) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  #ifdef HAVE_SNI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          wc_LockMutex(&srv->namedKeysMutex);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          FreeNamedKeyList(srv->namedKeys);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          wc_UnLockMutex(&srv->namedKeysMutex);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          wc_FreeMutex(&srv->namedKeysMutex);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  #endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          wolfSSL_CTX_free(srv->ctx);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      XFREE(srv, NULL, DYNAMIC_TYPE_SNIFFER_SERVER);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
